gates: waiter creates account with server-generated six-digit access code
order price and allergen snapshot are server-derived
required variants and removable ingredients are enforced
idempotent retry does not duplicate order or consume stock twice
oversell attempt rolls back the entire order and stock change
forged client price field is rejected
waiter change request requires Admin resolution and restores unstarted stock
primary kitchen station transitions RECEIVED to IN_PREPARATION to READY
Pass coordinates ready step and waiter delivery reaches SERVED
table move carries the open account and source becomes TO_RESET
temporary table merge/split works outside active service
public menu exposes inherited allergen data without operational station fields
notes: No persistent demo menu, table, account or order was created by these gates.
Realtime transport delivery is tested separately; this gate verifies authoritative signal generation, RLS and snapshot-reconciliation code paths.
